Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers and __a medial section positioned between the first and second layers__, __a first adhesive layer positioned between the first layer and the medial section__, __a second adhesive layer positioned between the second layer and the medial section__, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers.

Claim 282 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

Claim 283 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

Claim 284 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

Claim 285 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring, and wherein the weld ring is continuous.

Claim 286 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

Claim 287 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 286, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

Claim 288 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 286, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

Claim 289 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is segmented.

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring, and wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening.

Claim 293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, and wherein the weld ring is continuous.

Claim 294 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

Claim 295 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is segmented.
